components.name: Button
components.description: Default control: white wash, strong hairline, 12px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 600 13.5px/1 Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #efecf7; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14); border-radius: 12px; height: 38px; padding: 0 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c084fc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sliding chroma gradient; primary actions only.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font: 600 13.5px/1 Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fff; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; height: 38px; padding: 0 15px; cursor: pointer; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #8b5cf6, #c084fc, #e879f9, #c084fc, #8b5cf6); background-size: 300% 100%; animation: ds-chroma 6s linear infinite; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35), 0 10px 24px -10px color-mix(in oklab, #8b5cf6 80%, transparent); transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c084fc; outline-offset: 2px; } @keyframes ds-chroma { to { background-position: 300% 0; } }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive action: rose text, rose tint on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font: 600 13.5px/1 Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fb7185; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14); border-radius: 12px; height: 38px; padding: 0 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #fb7185 14%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, #fb7185 35%, transparent); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c084fc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Recessed black well with a violet focus halo.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font: 600 12px Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #a39cb6; } .ds-input { display: block; margin-top: 6px; font: 500 14px/1.2 Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #efecf7; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.32); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14); border-radius: 12px; height: 40px; padding: 0 13px; width: 100%; caret-color: #c084fc; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a83a0; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: color-mix(in oklab, #c084fc 60%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, #8b5cf6 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Black-well track; the active option is a lit white wash.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.32); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07); border-radius: 12px; padding: 3px; gap: 2px; } .ds-seg button { font: 600 12.5px/1 Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; height: 30px; border: 0; background: none; padding: 0 12px; color: #a39cb6; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05); color: #efecf7; } .ds-seg button.on { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.13); color: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.3), 0 4px 10px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c084fc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Liquid Glass Dock
components.description: The floating dock with tabs and the glass drop under the active one.
components.css: .ds-dock { position: relative; border-radius: 26px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.02) 38%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.035)), color-mix(in oklab, #8b5cf6 7%, rgb(12 10 20 / 0.5)); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(175%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.42), inset 0 -1px 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12), inset 1px 0 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14), inset 0 0 22px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05), 0 28px 60px -24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75), 0 2px 8px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4); } .ds-tabs { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 7px; } .ds-drop { position: absolute; top: 7px; left: 7px; width: 112px; height: 42px; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(170deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06) 55%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0.5px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.65), inset 0 -1px 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.18), 0 6px 14px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55), 0 0 22px -6px color-mix(in oklab, #c084fc 55%, transparent); } .ds-tab { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; height: 42px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; background: none; border-radius: 16px; color: #a39cb6; font: 600 13.5px/1 Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); color: #efecf7; } .ds-tab.on { color: #fff; background: none; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c084fc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Shelf Tile
components.description: Item on the shelf; selected gets the lilac halo, worn gets the turning chroma rim and the chroma badge.

anime-girl
64 Bilder · 1024 px
Getragen
components.css: .ds-tile { width: 132px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 12px 10px 10px; text-align: center; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.04); color: #efecf7; font-family: Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 0.2s, background-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-tile:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.07); } .ds-tile.selected { border-color: transparent; background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.09); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1.5px #c084fc, 0 0 0 5px color-mix(in oklab, #8b5cf6 22%, transparent), 0 14px 28px -14px color-mix(in oklab, #8b5cf6 80%, transparent); } .ds-prev { width: 46px; height: 74px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); box-shadow: 0 6px 14px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7); } .ds-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-meta { color: #8a83a0; font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 99px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #8b5cf6, #c084fc, #e879f9, #c084fc, #8b5cf6); background-size: 300% 100%; animation: ds-chroma2 6s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-chroma2 { to { background-position: 300% 0; } }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Top-centre status message with a glowing dot.
components.css: .ds-toast { position: relative; display: inline-block; border-radius: 16px; padding: 11px 16px 11px 38px; font: 600 13.5px Sora, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #efecf7; background: rgb(20 17 30 / 0.86); border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8); } .ds-toast::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 15px; top: 50%; width: 9px; height: 9px; margin-top: -4.5px; border-radius: 99px; background: #4ade80; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #4ade80; }

narrative.overview:
The player is the page. A large 3D Minecraft figure stands on a lit disc at the centre of a full-bleed violet shader, and every control lives in one floating Liquid Glass dock below it. Nothing is stacked as a settings page; on wide screens, Studio and Konto morph the dock into a right-hand sheet and the player slides left instead of being covered.

The mood is a night-time game lobby: deep ink, slow-moving violet and magenta fog, glass that bends light at its rim, and one animated chroma gradient reserved for what you act on or what you are wearing. Density is moderate and compact inside the dock (12-16px panel padding, 10px tile gaps) so the figure keeps the room. Every visual comes from the launcher, so the browser and the desktop app read as one product.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed animated fbm shader on ink (#09080e) with a 6% overlay grain; CSS radial-gradient fallback when WebGL is missing.
Floating chrome is Liquid Glass: specular inner rims, pointer-following light, lens refraction at the rim in Chromium.
One moving chroma gradient (violet, lilac, magenta) marks primary actions and worn items.
Sora for everything human; JetBrains Mono only for codes and numbers.
Corners run from 6px (pixel previews) to 28px (sign-in card); pills for status and the save bar.
German UI copy, sentence case, no uppercase labels.

rules.name: The Earned Chroma Rule
rules.body: The animated gradient `linear-gradient(90deg, violet, lilac, magenta, lilac, violet)` at `background-size: 300%`, sliding over 6s, appears only on: primary buttons, the "Getragen" badge, the rotating rim of a worn tile, the turntable disc rim, and the account avatar. Everything else is neutral. If chroma appears on anything not on this list, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Alpha-Not-Grey Rule
rules.body: Neutral surfaces are white or black alpha over the shader, never opaque greys. The dusk must show through every interior fill.

rules.name: The Machine Voice Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono with tabular figures is used for device codes, slider values and counts, and nowhere else. Sizes, names and prose stay in Sora.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase, no tracked-out small labels. Hierarchy comes from weight (400/600/700/800) and the text/muted/dim ladder.

rules.name: The Player Is the Page Rule
rules.body: The 3D figure owns the centre and is never covered: controls float in the dock, and when a panel needs height it becomes a side sheet that pushes the player aside. No stacked full-width sections.

rules.name: The Glass Floats, the Inside Stays Flat Rule
rules.body: Liquid Glass is only for chrome that floats over the shader. Nothing inside the dock is glass again; tiles, inputs and buttons inside use washes and wells.

rules.name: The Graceful Lens Rule
rules.body: The SVG displacement lens (chromatic rim refraction, `blur(3px) saturate(180%) brightness(1.06)`) is a Chromium enhancement. Every glass element must look finished with only `blur(22px) saturate(175%)`.

dos: Do keep the shader dusk full-bleed behind every state, with the radial-gradient fallback on ink (#09080e).
Do put new controls in the dock; if a feature needs height, make it a sheet tab that pushes the player aside (>= 1100px).
Do use the Liquid Glass recipe for anything that floats over the shader, and washes/wells for anything inside it.
Do reserve the sliding chroma gradient for primary actions and worn items (plus the existing turntable rim and avatar).
Do mark "shown on the player" with the lilac ring and halo, and "worn" with the turning chroma rim.
Do use JetBrains Mono with tabular figures for codes and numbers only.

Do move with the ease-out curve `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` for layout (0.6s) and the spring `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.36, 0.64, 1)` only for the tab drop; honour `prefers-reduced-motion` (shader freezes on one frame, animations collapse).
Do draw icons as 1.8px-stroke inline SVG in `currentColor`.
donts: Don't build stacked full-width settings sections or a scrolling page; the viewport is fixed and the player is the centre.
Don't cover the player with a modal or an overlay panel.
Don't nest glass inside glass or use opaque grey surfaces.
Don't use the chroma gradient for decoration, headings or secondary buttons.
Don't use uppercase or letter-spaced micro-labels, or hard offset shadows.
Don't depend on the SVG lens for legibility; it exists only in Chromium.
Don't set text below the dim value (#8a83a0) on ink.
